title: Observe European conditional lookup in Ability navigation
changes: Record a bounded positive ordinary Ability navigation using the EUR conditional four-byte lookup.
validation: One focused Wine production run of an existing 540-frame input reports 55 typed bytes across both fields; 199 guarded files and 691 frozen source hashes remain unchanged.
limitations: Counters are aggregate and do not identify individual instructions. Full scene comparison, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
